QuestInfo.name: Spiruna's Prophecy
QuestInfo.0: People say that #p2032001# in #m200000000# foretold an ominous prophecy. She's pretty feisty, but maybe you can convince her to tell you more.\r\n
QuestInfo.1: You met with #b#p2032001##k, and she told you that #m200000000# was going to fall and destroy everything. You asked how to stop it, but she's not saying anything. Talk to #b#p2032001##k again.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: #p2032001# refuses to tell you how to save #m200000000#, but #p2032001# might know something...\r\n

0.1: Ominous prophecy it is! Well this one's not TOO ominous. Just that #b#m200000000# is going to smash into the ground in a blaze of fire and destruction#k. Pretty soon, actually, unless my watch is slow.
0.2: Oh, you're the righteous explorer type, eh? Looking to save #m200000000#, huh?

yes.0: Are you confident, or just a knucklehead? There's no way you can save #m200000000#. It's hopeless.\r\n

no.0: How can you even call yourself an adventurer when all you care about is yourself? \r\n
